title: Florida House, District 68

candidates.name: Ryan Gill
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Sixth-generation Floridian who runs his family's cattle ranch in southeast Hillsborough County, land the family has worked for over 120 years. He was Farm Credit Agriculturalist of the Year in 2022 and serves on the Hillsborough County Cattlemen's Association board. Married with four children. His website lists no issue positions.

candidates.occupation: Former Tampa Fire Rescue firefighter and Hillsborough County Public Schools EMT
candidates.background: Former firefighter with Tampa Fire Rescue and emergency medical technician with Hillsborough County Public Schools. He ran for Plant City Commission in 2026, losing a May 26 runoff 53-47 percent. No campaign website or issue statements were found.
